reviewContext.userProblem: emaki highlights only JSON. It needs syntax highlighting for at least chilla's language inventory plus selected additions. The choice between tree-sitter, canvas-native line tokenizers and a hybrid must be explicit and measured.
requiredOutcomes: The design document records the approach decision with the measured comparison and maps all 85 chilla inventory entries (covered, or excluded with a reason).
Every non-excluded chilla language and every added language (typescript, tsx, jsx, vue, svelte, fish) highlights real tokens, verified by per-language fixture tests.
A selection API resolves languages by name, extension, filename and Markdown fence info string, with tests.
Embedded languages work in Markdown fences and HTML script/style, and also in PHP, server templates, Vue and Svelte.
npm run check, npm test and npm run build pass, and existing tests still pass.
scripts/perf includes per-language fixtures. The Chromium and WebKit budgets (first paint, scroll p95, key p95) pass, with results recorded.
The core entry bundle size is measured before and after and does not grow materially (at most 0.25 KB gzip).
The README documents the languages, the selection API, lazy loading and theme tags.
nonGoals: Shipping tree-sitter in emaki. The spike is evidence only and lives outside the repo.
Swapping the language at runtime on a live editor.
A public grammar-authoring API. grammar.ts and the families stay internal.
Semantic or type resolution, CommonMark-complete parsing, SCSS/Less grammars, and Svelte nested-brace expressions.
constraints: /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/vactr and /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/chilla are read-only and must not be modified.
emaki stays framework-independent with no vactr- or chilla-specific code. @codemirror/state and @codemirror/commands remain the only peer dependencies, and no dependencies are added.
Languages ship as per-language subpath exports (emaki/languages/<id>) and load lazily through emaki/languages. The '.' entry must not grow materially.

Public APIs stay backward compatible: the createEditor language option and the emaki/json and emaki/engine exports. These files are not edited: src/index.ts, src/engine.ts, src/language/index.ts, src/language/incremental.ts, src/language/json*.ts, src/render/*, src/editor.ts and src/types.ts.
Grammar sources must have MIT-compatible licenses and be recorded in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. The Swift and Nix grammars are written fresh, without copying chilla's grammars.
All commands run in the foreground, with the exit code and complete log path recorded.
The commit uses the numbered 1-6 commit-message style and is not pushed.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Provisional canvas-native approach: emaki-original declarative grammars compile to LineLanguage<string> and run on the unchanged IncrementalHighlighter. This needs no wasm, no async init and no packaging beyond peer dependencies. The decision is confirmed only if design §3.3 (a)-(e) hold, with measured evidence in §10.
Embeds use a composite string state, which keeps checkpoint equality and the LRU cache working.
The family factories (cLike, lispLike, shellLike, markupLike, iniLike) return a GrammarDef that language modules extend, which keeps 71 modules maintainable.
Languages added beyond chilla: dedicated typescript, tsx and jsx modules (chilla aliases them to JavaScript), plus vue, svelte and fish. zsh, ksh and sh are aliases of bash.
The registry loads each language through a dynamic import, so import 'emaki' pulls in no languages.
intentionalTradeoffs: Line-tokenizer fidelity instead of full parse trees, per the fidelity contract in design §6.
Template hosts restart HTML from its start state after a server block.
During parallel waves, the workspace-wide check and boundary logs are informational. The exit-0 gates run serially at P09 and at reconcile.
Expectations live in test/language/expectations/<group>.ts instead of design §9.1's test/fixtures/languages/expectations.ts, because tsconfig excludes test/fixtures/languages (low, documented).
supportedEdgeCases: Lines longer than 4096 characters, where a comment or script end crosses offset 4096 (design §9.1 a-d).
After a mid-file one-character edit, the incremental tokens equal a fresh tokenization.
A fence whose language is not loaded renders as string, and closing the fence restores Markdown tags.
Fence info forms ts, ' rust ignore', {.python} and js,linenos; longest-suffix filenames x.html.erb, x.d.ts and x.js.erb; case-insensitive resolution.
Astral characters and zero-length rules neither split surrogates nor loop.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Svelte '}' inside expressions, multi-line Vue opening tags, and HTML inner state across server blocks.
Python regex sub-highlighting inside strings (chilla row 52 is excluded), Perl format blocks, and SQL dialects.
Lisp reader macros beyond quoting, layout-rule parsing, and YAML flow-collection validation.
residualRisks: The approach decision stays provisional until P12 measures its evidence. Spike network access and ABI availability are unknown (user-QA item 2).
A canvas language may miss a perf budget. This is routed to the owning plan for serial repair, and budgets are not relaxed.
Sibling-owned compile or boundary failures first appear at the P09 serial gate.
